root_cause: scripts/testing/process_harness/atomic_json_file.gd replaces an existing file by renaming target to a unique backup and then renaming temp to target. During that interval target is absent.

On Windows, Godot DirAccess.rename itself also removes an existing destination before MoveFileW, so a naive single temp->target rename through the same API would still contain a destination-absence window.
M5 Support.read collapses NOT_FOUND, OPEN_FAILED, EMPTY and INCOMPLETE reads into an empty Dictionary.
After convergence release becomes monotonic, the client integrity guard interprets one transient empty control read as a real control-generation regression.

R7 evidence shows the final control file is intact and prepare/release/complete all reference the same generation, proving the observed empty control was transient rather than a persistent semantic rollback.

rejected: claiming DirAccess.rename(temp,target) is atomic on Windows
falling back indefinitely to stale backup control files
selected: Keep AtomicJson.read_dictionary as the typed one-shot primitive.
Add an explicit bounded typed read retry helper for continuity-sensitive readers. Only NOT_FOUND, OPEN_FAILED, EMPTY and INCOMPLETE are retryable.
Bound the retry horizon to the writer replacement budget: MAX_REPLACE_ATTEMPTS plus a small margin at RETRY_DELAY_MS.
A valid JSON empty Dictionary is a successful read and is never treated as transient; it therefore still triggers fail-closed convergence semantics.
M5 control reads use the bounded typed helper. If retryable read errors persist beyond the bounded window, the client fails explicitly with M5_CONTROL_READ_UNAVAILABLE.
Result/report polling remains on existing non-blocking Support.read behavior.

authorized_changes: Add AtomicJson.is_transient_read_error and read_dictionary_with_retry with explicit attempts/elapsed/error evidence.
Add Support.read_control_consistent as the only M5 control-plane bounded read entry point.
Replace direct Support.read(_control_file) in all M5 control-dependent driver stages with typed consistent reads and explicit M5_CONTROL_READ_UNAVAILABLE after retry exhaustion.

Add a deterministic regression that proves missing and incomplete JSON can recover within the bounded retry window, valid empty JSON succeeds immediately, and persistent missing reads exhaust with a typed error.
Wire the new regression into RUN_NETWORK_CONTRACT_TESTS.ps1 and contract guards.
non_goals: Do not alter R7 observed-state identity or convergence barrier semantics.
Do not accept stale backup data as current control.
Do not add retries to gameplay/network operations or convergence generations.
acceptance_r8: M5 contracts PASS with control-read continuity guards.
m5_control_read_consistency_regression PASS, including real delayed recovery from NOT_FOUND and INCOMPLETE using the same helper.
R7 release-guard regression remains PASS 31/0 or greater with unchanged semantics.
Windows exact-Godot M5 stability gate reaches 10/10 with no hidden reruns.
A transient control replace gap must not produce CONTROL_GENERATION_REGRESSED_AFTER_RELEASE.
A valid persistent empty control or a persistent unreadable/missing control beyond the bounded horizon must still fail explicitly.
Only after Windows 10/10 may one canonical full world regression first attempt be run.
